title: PLAYER 2 SEES HIS TEAMMATE'S FLASH AT THE MUZZLE
why: Since the guns were drawn bigger (v27.10), the shooters own window draws the muzzle flash and starts the tracer at the drawn muzzle (39 out and 20 up for a rifle), but the tracer word carried only the spawn point, so the other window drew the flash and the tracer start inside the gun (17 out). Proven in the cloud: a host rifle shot east drew the flash at 39,-20 on the host and at 17,-13 on the partner window, the partner tracer with no muzzle distance; the same aiming west. The word now carries the tracers muzzle distance and the flash point on its end; the other window uses them the way the shooters window does. Old windows ignore the extra numbers. Cosmetic only; the round is unchanged.
now: In co-op your teammates muzzle flash and tracer start at the end of his gun, as they do on his screen.
